reuseRule: Multiple gameItemIds intentionally resolve to the same iconKey. Never create one bitmap/drawable per item.

tmo61_r754.note: Canonical English item names and stable gameItemId identity; current production JSON baseline.

items.name: Deodorant
items.note: Deodorant uses the smoke icon family and light-blue color.

items.name: Poisoned Meat
items.note: Poisoned Meat uses the meat icon family in purple.

items.name: Tinged Meat
items.note: Tinged/Tainted Meat (シビレ生肉) uses the meat icon family in yellow.

items.name: Drugged Meat
items.note: Drugged/Sleep Meat (眠り生肉) uses the meat icon family in light blue.

items.name: Flash Bomb
items.note: Flash Bomb is the classic thrown-ball icon in yellow.

items.name: Sonic Bomb
items.note: Sonic Bomb is the classic thrown-ball icon in gray; PAL_13 is the dark/gray classic palette in the MHP3DB atlas.

items.name: Dung Bomb
items.note: Dung Bomb deliberately uses the dung icon family, not the generic thrown-ball glyph; Dung Bomb is yellow.

items.name: Pitfall Trap
items.note: Pitfall Trap is green in the classic icon system.

items.name: Barrel Bomb L
items.note: Large Barrel Bomb uses the lit barrel-bomb family and red color.

items.name: Nulberry
items.note: Nulberry uses the seed/fruit icon family and is blue in the classic color system.

items.name: Pale Extract
items.note: Pale Extract uses the classic extract/liquid icon; MHP3 changed it to white. Atlas family cell matches other liquid/extract items.

items.name: Fertile Mud
items.note: Fertile Mud uses the dung icon family; an MHP3-era discussion explicitly notes the same icon as Wyvern Droppings. Orange follows the Wyvern Droppings dung-color group.

items.name: Wyvern Tear
items.note: Wyvern Tear uses the old monster-part/corpse icon family; source color grouping aligns it with Bird Wyvern Gem's palette.

items.name: Lrg Wyvern Tear
items.note: Large Wyvern Tear shares the Wyvern Tear icon identity.

items.name: Beast Tear
items.note: Beast Tear uses the old monster-part/corpse icon family; its color group matches Wyvern Stone/Dragon Gem family examples.

items.name: Lrg Beast Tear
items.note: Large Beast Tear shares the Beast Tear icon identity; size/rank variant does not require a separate drawable.
